purpose: Classify CLR-003 through CLR-016 against exact current V5 and inventory evidence without creating stock, preparation, formula, experiment, or release authority.

classification_policy.FORMULA_REBASE_REQUIRED: The usable stock basis is named, but every affected historical formula must be deterministically rebound while preserving active mass and carrier contribution.
classification_policy.FORMULA_REBASE_AND_STOCK_LINEAGE_REQUIRE: A different-strength stock is named, but both deterministic formula rebasing and exact stock or preparation lineage remain open.
classification_policy.CARRIER_IDENTITY_THEN_PHYSICAL_PREPARATI: The parent carrier must be proven before a child dilution can be prepared and receipted.
classification_policy.PHYSICAL_PREPARATION_OR_LABEL_REQUIRED: Current text does not supply the exact label, carrier, stock identity, or executed preparation receipt required by the closure test.

audits.present_evidence: Inventory and V5 distinguish neat Helional from a 10% v/v stock.
audits.missing_gate: Exact carrier, parent stock identity, preparation lineage, and a receipt preserving v/v without converting to w/w.
audits.next_safe_action: Inspect the physical label and preparation record; preserve v/v as a separate basis and keep all 27 rows held until bound.

audits.present_evidence: V5 asserts neat plus 10%, while inventory text names only the material.
audits.missing_gate: Explicit 10% carrier and a distinct exact stock or label identity.
audits.next_safe_action: Bind the existing 10% bottle label and carrier or prepare and receipt a distinct child stock; do not infer strength from the material name.

audits.material_scope: Javanol historical neat rows to confirmed 20% in DPG

snapshot_sources.status: DO NOT USE — NEAT STOCK NOT CONFIRMED

audits.present_evidence: V5 identifies the 20% in DPG stock and holds 53 historical neat-basis rows.
audits.missing_gate: Reviewed mass-basis equivalence and exact rebinding of every affected formula to the confirmed 20% stock.
audits.next_safe_action: Generate and review a content-addressed rebase candidate for the 53 rows; keep original formulas immutable until accepted.

audits.material_scope: Alpha Irone 10% gap versus owned 30% w/w in IPM
audits.present_evidence: Inventory and V5 name an owned 30% w/w in IPM stock while the 10% basis is a gap.
audits.missing_gate: Per-row active-mass-preserving rebase with IPM carrier accounting; volumetric 10%-to-30% substitution is forbidden.
audits.next_safe_action: Create a reviewed mass-basis rebase candidate for the 12 held rows and preserve exact parent hashes.

audits.material_scope: Beta Ionone 1% historical rows versus owned 0.1% stock
audits.present_evidence: Inventory distinguishes neat Beta Ionone from a 0.1% in TEC working dilution.
audits.missing_gate: Exact lineage for the 0.1% stock plus deterministic rebasing of the two historical 1% rows, or a separately receipted 1% stock.
audits.next_safe_action: Bind the 0.1% preparation lineage, then rebase the two rows by active dose; do not dose 0.1% as 1%.

audits.material_scope: Peru Balsam 50% w/w to 10% working stock
audits.present_evidence: Inventory text asserts DPG, while V5 deliberately keeps the 50% parent carrier unstated.
audits.missing_gate: Physical label or lot evidence for the parent carrier, followed by a gravimetric 10% PreparationReceipt and row rebinding.
audits.next_safe_action: Verify the parent product label first; only then prepare and receipt the 10% child stock and rebind all 43 rows.

audits.missing_gate: A homogeneous 10% child stock with exact parent, carrier, quantities, basis, date, and stock ID.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt a 10% child stock only after separate physical authorization; keep old 10% assumptions held.

audits.material_scope: Carrot Seed EO 1% and 10% working stocks
audits.present_evidence: Only neat Carrot Seed EO is confirmed.
audits.missing_gate: Separate exact preparation receipts for each actually needed 1% or 10% child stock.
audits.next_safe_action: Select only required strengths, then physically prepare and receipt each child stock under separate authorization.

audits.missing_gate: A current gravimetric 10% in DPG PreparationReceipt and exact child stock ID.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt the child stock only when needed and separately authorized.

audits.present_evidence: Only neat Methyl Nonyl Ketone is confirmed.
audits.missing_gate: A 1% child receipt with exact parent, carrier, fraction basis, quantities, date, and stock ID.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt the 1% child stock only after separate physical authorization.

audits.present_evidence: Inventory confirms neat and 1% in DPG stocks, not the required 10% child stock.
audits.missing_gate: An exact 10% child stock and carrier receipt bound to the affected rows.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt a distinct 10% child only when required; never substitute the existing 1% stock.

audits.present_evidence: Only neat Dihydro Beta Ionone is confirmed.
audits.missing_gate: A current exact 10% PreparationReceipt and child stock identity.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt the 10% child only when separately authorized; do not dose neat as historical 10%.

audits.present_evidence: Only neat Heliotropal or Piperonal is confirmed; Heliotropin remains a separate identity boundary.
audits.missing_gate: An exact 10% child stock with carrier contribution preserved.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt a distinct 10% child stock only when separately authorized.

audits.present_evidence: Only neat Methyl Anthranilate is confirmed.
audits.missing_gate: An exact receipted 10% child stock before any affected formula is executable.
audits.next_safe_action: Prepare and receipt the 10% child only when separately authorized.

delegation_evidence.observed_efficiency_finding: A single 14-node client admitted seven jobs and returned seven daemon transport failures without job IDs; after settlement and a fresh READY check, a separate seven-node client admitted and completed all seven.
